objective: Preallocate subquery local-scope schema lookup keys from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate SUBQUERY schema keys
tasks.result: Subquery table-factor and local-scope schema lookups now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for schema:<table> keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for schema:<table> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in table_factor_schema_if_simple_table() and append_local_scope_for_factor().
Generated schema key bytes, subquery materialization, correlated EXISTS membership, CTE behavior, recursive query behavior, and join-side query behavior are unchanged.
